desc: positive: Test FQ_CODEL with ETS parent - force packet drop with empty queue
pre: ip link add v0p1 type veth peer name v0p0 && ip link set v0p1 up && ip link set v0p0 up
ip link add ifbtdc0 type ifb && ip link set ifbtdc0 up
tc qdisc add dev ifbtdc0 handle 1: root ets bands 2 strict 1
tc class change dev ifbtdc0 parent 1: classid 1:1 ets
tc qdisc add dev ifbtdc0 parent 1:1 handle 10: fq_codel memory_limit 1 flows 1 target 0.1ms interval 1ms
tc filter add dev ifbtdc0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 1 0xff flowid 1:1
tc qdisc add dev v0p1 ingress
tc filter add dev v0p1 ingress protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 1 0xff action mirred egress mirror dev ifbtdc0

readback.cmd: tc -s qdisc show dev ifbtdc0 | grep -A 5 'qdisc fq_codel'
readback.name: verify
